_readme: Per-portal harvest rules, keyed by source id (see `registry_info` or `find_sources`). Anything not listed uses the defaults.
`skip` means never call this portal, with the reason reported in every harvest's stats.
`cadence` sets how often each portal is read. `publish_gate` sets when the harvest workflow refuses to publish a new index (see README, "The nightly harvest").

defaults.esri_org_ids_note: Only org ids seen live are listed (P3ePLMYs2RVChkJx: Esri's own national layers on Monroe's portal, probe 6, 2026-11-05). Items owned by another org are excluded from a portal anyway (see own-org rule), so this list is a second guard, not the main one.

by_entity.Association for Neighborhood and Housing: Account-gated portal with a data-access policy. Never called.
by_entity.Rockland County: Blocks automated clients (Scout eval, 2026-11-05). Skipped; never worked around.
by_entity.Columbia University Libraries: GeoBlacklight with 104,570 records, mostly not New York. Excluded from the harvest.

adapters._note: One on/off switch per adapter (issue #16). Set enabled to false to stop one adapter without touching the rest; its portals are reported as 'adapter-off' by the harvest stats and the coverage command, and their datasets stay in the index as last read. An adapter not listed here is on.

arcgis-server.note: ArcGIS Server REST directories with no catalog in front (issue #16, milestone 4). Read weekly per host, within arcgis_server.max_requests_per_host.

hand-kept.note: data/hand-kept.json: what rows with no data link offer (issue #16, milestone 5, D6). No network calls.

geoblacklight.note: GeoBlacklight records read from the institution's OpenGeoMetadata repository on GitHub (one archive per read), never from the GeoBlacklight site (issue #16, milestone 6).

invenio-rdm.note: Off until a supervised run (harvest --only new-york-university-libraries--ultraviolet-library-nyu-edu --ignore-cadence) shows the New York filter works: InvenioRDM locations are optional, and NYU's Spatial Data Repository holds places worldwide. Records without a location are kept only when they name New York.

allow_no_portal._note: Registry rows marked 'no-portal' that still document a data endpoint, let through to one adapter (epic #7, decision D4). `endpoint` must still appear in the row's api_endpoint, or the row is skipped until checked again. Each was checked to be New York, not a look-alike.

City of Utica.checked_new_york: Registry evidence (2026-11-05): the city's own GIS Maps page links an Experience in org MBcb1JDktb5ipmv9, named 'The City of Utica, NY'. The 'Lead Safe Community - Utica' Hub (lead-service-line-inventory-uticamn) is Utica, Minnesota, and is not used.

Wyoming County.checked_new_york: Registry evidence (2026-11-05): org wyco (Sq7KUOgahdDkqoAp) is named 'Wyoming County GIS'; its items' median center is -78.22, 42.69 (Warsaw, NY). The old Hub www-wyomingcounty-wycopa belonged to Wyoming County, Pennsylvania, and is not used.

City of Mount Vernon.checked_new_york: Registry evidence (2026-11-05): the city's own Infrastructure Dashboard page (mountvernonny.gov/2052) links gis.cmvny.com/portal; its City_Boundary layer returns NAME 'Mount Vernon', 4.40 sq mi, in NAD83 / New York East.

arcgis_server._note: The ArcGIS Server REST directory adapter (issue #16, D5). Per host and per read: at most max_requests_per_host requests in all (listing, services and layer fields), min_interval_ms between them (robots.txt Crawl-delay still wins when longer), utility folders skipped, at most max_layers_per_service layer field requests per service, and no new request after max_seconds_per_host. A host that hits the cap is marked partial and nothing is marked removed.

geoblacklight._note: OpenGeoMetadata repository for each GeoBlacklight registry row, by source id (issue #16, milestone 6). The adapter downloads the repository archive once per read through the GitHub REST API, keeps public, unsuppressed, not-withdrawn records from `provider`, and drops records wholly outside New York. Columbia's GeoBlacklight is excluded in skip.by_entity.

invenio_rdm._note: InvenioRDM community records (NYU UltraViolet). page_size 25 is the documented example; at most max_pages pages per read.

cadence._note: Days between reads. Self-hosted county ArcGIS portals (the `enterprise` adapter) and ArcGIS Server REST directories (`arcgis-server`) are read weekly, to be gentle on small county servers (epic #7, decision D5). Everything else nightly. A portal is due `slack_hours` early so a late scheduled start does not slip a whole week. `harvest --ignore-cadence` reads everything.

publish_gate._note: The workflow publishes only when every check passes (or a person overrides it with a written reason, which is recorded in gate.json, index.json and the release notes). Compared with the index that is published now. Portals the harvest drops because their ids left the registry are subtracted before the drop checks, up to max_registry_removed_portals of them.
